map.由离子浓度求溶度积或反之: Finding the solubility product from ion concentrations, or vice versa
map.输入阴阳离子浓度与化学计量指数，求溶度积 Ksp。: Enter the cation and anion concentrations with their stoichiometric exponents to get the solubility product Ksp.
map.📖 查看「由离子浓度求溶度积或反之 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Finding the Solubility Product from Ion Concentrations or Vice Versa Usage Guide"
map.📚 深度解析：由离子浓度求溶度积或反之: 📚 Deep Dive: Finding the Solubility Product from Ion Concentrations or Vice Versa
map.饱和浓度：给定 Ksp 算单一离子饱和浓度（如 AgCl）。: Saturation concentration: given Ksp, compute the saturation concentration of a single ion (such as AgCl).
map.离子积 Qsp 判定：现浓度算 Qsp，Qsp>Ksp 提示沉淀。: Ion product Qsp test: compute Qsp from the current concentrations; Qsp > Ksp indicates precipitation.
map.同离子效应：共离子降低溶解度。: Common-ion effect: a shared ion lowers the solubility.
map.输入 Ksp=1.8e-10，工具输出 [Ag⁺]饱和≈1.34×10⁻⁵ M，: Enter Ksp = 1.8e-10, the tool outputs a saturated [Ag⁺] ≈ 1.34×10⁻⁵ M and notes that adding Cl⁻ lowers the solubility through the common-ion effect.
map.Qsp>Ksp 一定沉淀？: Does Qsp > Ksp always mean precipitation?
map.过饱和可能暂未沉淀（亚稳），扰动后析出；热力学判定以 Qsp>Ksp 为准。: Supersaturated solutions may stay clear for a while (metastable) and only settle out after a disturbance; thermodynamically Qsp > Ksp is the criterion.
map.共离子使溶解度降（勒夏特列原理）。: A shared ion lowers the solubility (Le Chatelier principle).
map.弱酸根盐（如 CaF₂）受 [H⁺] 影响（F⁻ 质子化），pH 升溶解度变。: Salts of weak-acid anions (such as CaF₂) are affected by [H⁺] (F⁻ protonation), so solubility changes as pH rises.
